title: State
description: DESIGN-level schema. Represents State or State Estimate per docs/foundations/TERMINOLOGY.md. No implementation exists yet.

stateId.description: Unique identifier for this state record.

owner.description: The single owning component/layer for this state, per architecture/LAYER_CONTRACTS.md.

kind.description: Distinguishes authoritative State from a computed State Estimate.

value.description: Domain-specific state representation. No physical values are prescribed here.

derivedFrom.description: Telemetry or state IDs this value was derived from, required when kind is STATE_ESTIMATE.
